GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 311 (9 Sep 47) CCS
(SCAPIN - 1771/3)
APO 500
28 March 1949
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Relaxation of International Telecommunications Restrictions.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for the Japanese Government, file AG 311(9 Sep 47)CCS, SCAPIN 1771, dated 9 September 1947, subject same as above, as amended.
2. Paragraph 7a (1) (b) of the reference memorandum is rescinded and the following substituted therefor:
(b) Messages which relate to the conversion, transfer, or disguising of any Japanese external assets by powers of attorney, proxies, instructions, or other means intended to defeat SCAP regulations regarding foreign exchange or the conversion of external assets, except that messages which relate to applications by Japanese or residents of Japan are admitted to and from Japan when they relate to the return of their property which has been vested in the Alien Property Custodian of the United States.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
